name: Fuel efficiency comparison
pitch: Show the fuel economy figures for two car models side by side to help decide which is more efficient.
instructions: Start by asking the person which two car models they are comparing. When the names are given, open a web search for the first model's fuel efficiency. Read the official specs or a trusted review page. Note the combined mpg or litres per 100 km figure. Then repeat for the second model. When both figures are found, use show_comparison to display them side by side. If a figure cannot be found, say so plainly and offer to look up another source or a different model. End by asking the person if they need more details such as boot space or running costs.

examples.ask: I'm deciding between a Toyota Yaris and a Ford Fiesta
examples.does: search for the official mpg of the Toyota Yaris, then the Ford Fiesta, and show the figures side by side

examples.ask: what's the fuel consumption of a Honda Jazz
examples.does: look up the WLTP combined fuel economy for the Honda Jazz and tell the person the figure

readme: Compare the fuel efficiency of two car models. Uses web search to find official mpg or l/100km figures. Shows a side-by-side comparison. Will not give advice on which car to buy or list prices.
